_comment: Generic overland bed rack (original geometry, unbranded) on the reference pickup: powder-coated black frame clamped to the bed rails, MOLLE-slotted side panels, crossbars just below the cab roof; full loadout = hard-shell rooftop tent, 2 recovery boards, 2 jerry cans, shovel, packed awning, light bar, cargo case in the bed. camper.loadout 'bare' renders the rack alone. Render-only; nothing here is exported.
